name: TSOP38238 IR receiver with NEC remote
description: Vishay TSOP38238 38 kHz IR receiver module (OUT active low with its own 30 kOhm pull-up, the data sheet's output delay and pulse width) with the 21-key NEC remote sold with Arduino kits pointed at it: pressing a key sends its NEC frame, holding it sends repeat codes every 108 ms.

pins.name: OUT
pins.doc: Output, active low; the part's 30 kOhm pull-up to VS

address.doc: The remote's NEC address: 0 to 255 (sent with its complement), or a 16-bit extended address (the kit remote: 0)

inputs.name: key
inputs.doc: The remote key held ('none' when released)

functional.claims: OUT active low with the part's 30 kOhm pull-up: low 10 carrier cycles (263 us) after each 38 kHz burst starts, for the burst's length; the kit remote's NEC frames (9 ms + 4.5 ms leader, address and complement, command and complement LSB first, 562.5 us bursts with 562.5 or 1687.5 us spaces, a closing burst) and repeat codes every 108 ms while a key is held; no output below 2.0 V.
omissions: distance, angle and the remote's battery (every frame arrives)
ambient light, the AGC and noise pulses
the spread of the output delay (7 to 13 carrier cycles) and of the pulse width (+-5 cycles) between parts
protocols other than NEC and other carrier frequencies

electrical.claims: OUT bridges to its net: low at the data sheet's 0.1 V, high through the 30 kOhm pull-up; VS below 2.0 V keeps it high; the behaviour is the Lua model's.
